name: Knight Cat AI Video: Make Your Cat or Dog the Kitten Knight
blurb: The knight cat AI video, also called the cat knight or the cat with a sword meme, is the viral clip of a tiny kitten in fitted silver armor, gripping a sword twice its height and refusing to step back in a storm on a misty moor.

prompts.label: 1. Open [AI Photo with this template](https://www.makeviral.ai/photo?template=knight-cat-ai-video) and add your photo (your pet, whole body). The photo prompt is filled in
prompts.text: Use the uploaded image as the base. Keep the animal's breed, face, eye color, fur color, fur length and markings exactly the same as in the photo. Turn the animal into a tiny, brave knight in a still from a real film. The animal stands upright on its hind legs and wears a full suit of fitted miniature medieval plate armor made for its small body: a polished, slightly scratched steel breastplate, rounded steel shoulder plates, jointed steel plates on the front legs, a short chainmail skirt, steel plates and small steel boots on the hind legs, leather straps with small brass buckles, and a short cream linen cape that whips sideways in the wind. No helmet: the head, face, ears and fur stay fully visible. With both front paws it grips the hilt of a real plain steel longsword at chest height and holds it straight up, point to the sky, just beside its face, so the blade never hides the face. The blade rises far above its ears, so the sword is about twice as tall as the animal. A strong wind blows from the left: the fur on its head and cheeks streams sideways. Its big eyes are open and look ahead, calm and brave. It is alone in the middle of a wide, misty moor of long, wet, green grass, with thick fog hiding the horizon. Overcast, soft, cool light, muted grey-green colors. Low camera at the animal's eye level, long lens, shallow depth of field, soft blurred grass in the foreground. Full body from ears to feet, with the whole sword in frame and open misty sky above. Photorealistic, natural film grain, not CGI, not a cartoon. Vertical 9:16. Exactly one animal, no people, no extra paws, no text or letters on the sword, no logos.

prompts.label: 3. Press the film button on the still to open AI Video with the still as the first frame. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text: A slow, epic, cinematic scene on a misty moor, filmed like a real movie. Keep the animal's face, fur, markings and armor exactly as in the image. The little knight holds its ground in a strong, gusting wind: its fur streams sideways, the short cream cape snaps and flutters, the long grass ripples in waves and mist drifts past. For the first seconds it stands perfectly still and calm, gripping the tall sword. Then a huge gust hits: it narrows its eyes, grips the sword tighter with both front paws, plants its feet and leans into the wind without taking a step back. As the gust passes, it slowly lifts its chin and looks bravely ahead into the fog. The sword stays straight up the whole time. The camera stays low and close at the animal's eye level with a gentle handheld drift and a very slow push in, so the little knight stays big in the frame the whole time. Natural, real animal motion. Audio: loud howling wind and the cape flapping from the first second, soft clinks of armor, then an original slow, epic orchestral score with deep drums and strings that swells when the big gust hits. No people, no extra paws, no morphing, no text, no logos.

Use the two uploaded images as the base. The person in the first image is the big knight. The animal in the second image is the little knight. Keep the person's face, facial features, skin tone, hair and body shape exactly the same as in their photo. Keep the animal's breed, face, eye color, fur color and markings exactly the same as in its photo. Do not blend the person and the animal. A still from a real film on a wide, misty moor of long, wet, green grass, with thick fog hiding the horizon, overcast soft cool light and a strong wind from the left. In the front, the animal stands upright on its hind legs in a full suit of fitted miniature medieval plate armor made for its small body: a polished steel breastplate, rounded steel shoulder plates, jointed plates on the front legs, a short chainmail skirt, steel plates and small steel boots on the hind legs, leather straps, small brass buckles and a short cream cape that whips in the wind. No helmet on the animal. With both front paws it grips a real plain steel longsword at chest height and holds it straight up, point to the sky, just beside its face; the blade rises far above its ears. A few steps behind the animal and to the right, the person stands tall in full polished steel plate armor with no helmet and a long dark red cape with gold trim that streams in the wind. The person holds a longsword point-down at their side, with a calm, proud face and a faint, gentle smile, the face turned three-quarters toward the camera. Low camera at the animal's eye level. The animal is full body from ears to feet, the person is full body from head to feet, and both faces are clear and sharp. Photorealistic, natural film grain, muted grey-green colors, not CGI. Vertical 9:16. Exactly one person and one animal, no extra paws, no extra limbs, no text or letters on the swords, no logos.

Keep the person's face, hair and armor and the animal's face, fur and markings exactly as in the image. The little animal knight stands in front and holds its ground, gripping the tall sword while its fur and short cape stream in the wind. Their faces stay visible in three-quarter view, never turned away from the camera. One continuous shot with no cuts. The camera stays low and almost still, with a slight handheld sway. Natural motion. No dialogue, no lyrics. Exactly one person and one animal. No smoke, no fire, no extra limbs or paws, no merged bodies, no morphing, no text, no logos.
